# @fazelstudio/codemirror-lang-prisma

[![NPM version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fazelstudio/codemirror-lang-prisma.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fazelstudio/codemirror-lang-prisma)

Prisma Schema Language (`.prisma`) support for the [CodeMirror](https://codemirror.net/) code editor. Built with a full Lezer grammar covering all Prisma constructs, syntax highlighting, code folding, automatic indentation, and autocomplete.

## Features

- **Full grammar** — `datasource`, `generator`, `model`, `enum`, `type` blocks
- **Field declarations** — scalar types, optional (`?`), list (`[]`) modifiers
- **Attributes** — field-level (`@id`, `@default()`, `@unique`, `@relation()`, `@map()`, `@updatedAt`, `@ignore`) and block-level (`@@map()`, `@@unique()`, `@@index()`, `@@id()`, `@@ignore`)
- **Doc comments** (`///`) — highlighted separately from regular comments (`//`)
- **Autocomplete** — keywords, types, attributes, and built-in functions
- **Code folding** — fold blocks by `{ }`
- **Auto indentation** — proper indentation inside blocks
- **Dual output** — ESM + CJS + TypeScript declarations

## Installation

```bash
npm install @fazelstudio/codemirror-lang-prisma
```

## Usage

### Basic (syntax highlighting only)

```js
import { EditorView, basicSetup } from "codemirror"
import { prisma } from "@fazelstudio/codemirror-lang-prisma"

new EditorView({
  parent: document.body,
  doc: `model User {\n  id    Int    @id @default(autoincrement())\n  email String @unique\n}`,
  extensions: [basicSetup, prisma()],
})
```

### With autocomplete

```js
import { EditorView, basicSetup } from "codemirror"
import { prisma, prismaAutocomplete } from "@fazelstudio/codemirror-lang-prisma"

new EditorView({
  parent: document.body,
  extensions: [basicSetup, prisma(), prismaAutocomplete],
})
```

### Custom completion source

```js
import { prismaCompletionSource } from "@fazelstudio/codemirror-lang-prisma"

// Use with your own completion config
const myCompletion = autocompletion({
  override: [prismaCompletionSource],
})
```

## API

### `prisma() → LanguageSupport`

Returns a `LanguageSupport` instance with the Prisma grammar, syntax highlighting, indentation, and code folding.

### `prismaLanguage: LRLanguage`

The underlying `LRLanguage` object for advanced usage.

### `prismaAutocomplete: Extension`

An autocomplete extension that provides completions for Prisma keywords, types, attributes, and functions.

### `prismaCompletionSource: CompletionSource`

A completion source function that can be used with `@codemirror/autocomplete`'s `autocompletion({ override: [...] })`.

### Autocomplete completions

| Category | Items |
|----------|-------|
| **Block keywords** | `model`, `enum`, `type`, `datasource`, `generator` |
| **Scalar types** | `String`, `Int`, `Boolean`, `DateTime`, `Float`, `Json`, `Bytes`, `Decimal`, `BigInt` |
| **Field attributes** | `@id`, `@default()`, `@unique`, `@relation()`, `@map()`, `@updatedAt`, `@ignore` |
| **Block attributes** | `@@map()`, `@@unique()`, `@@index()`, `@@id()`, `@@ignore` |
| **Functions** | `autoincrement()`, `now()`, `cuid()`, `uuid()`, `dbgenerated()`, `env()` |
| **Config keys** | `provider`, `url`, `output`, `binaryTargets`, `previewFeatures` |

## Known limitations

- `dbgenerated("...")` SQL content is highlighted as a plain string, not as nested SQL.
- Schema validation (e.g. checking `@relation` references) is out of scope — this package only provides syntax highlighting, parsing, and autocomplete, not a language server.
- No multi-file `import` support (Prisma preview feature, still evolving).
